command: A powerful Black Rose luxury streetwear campaign: two confident customers and their exact mapped garments in a restrained nocturnal black-stone gallery, with the exact font sculpture grounded as a deliberate physical monument. Product and customer first, professional wide editorial hierarchy, one coherent light and ground plane.
SkyyRose Black Rose is nocturnal gothic luxury streetwear: urban monumentality, controlled menace, cinematic restraint, exact product authority, no generic filler.

Male wears exact BR-005 Signature Edition hoodie with exact BR-007 basketball shorts. Female wears the exact founder-supplied BR-004 long hoodie dress. Preserve construction, logos, wordmarks, placement, color, cast identity, and the exact Black Rose font sculpture. No BR-001, BR-002, bridge, waterfront, star monument, extra people, or invented text.

prompts.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Wide 16:9 cinematic banner composition. Nocturnal black-stone gallery interior, single unified ground plane of polished dark marble reflecting both figures and the font sculpture with restrained specular continuity.

[FOCAL SUBJECT]
Two subjects standing on one continuous polished black marble floor inside a vast, column-flanked black stone gallery. Male subject at left third of frame: tall Black man, natural black hair, confident neutral expression, wearing the exact BR-005 Signature Edition hoodie — matte charcoal-black heavyweight fleece, white drawstrings, small Black Rose emblem embroidered at left chest, large detailed black rose with cloud and thorns graphic screenprinted along the left sleeve from elbow to cuff — paired with the exact BR-007 basketball shorts — black mesh body with all-over tonal dark rose repeat pattern, white varsity "OAKLAND" wordmark arched across the front panel, script cursive secondary wordmark overlapping at right, white-and-black geometric chevron trim panels at sides, white waistband, white side-stripe accents — white crew socks, white low-top sneakers. Female subject at right third of frame: tall Black woman, long wavy black hair loose over shoulders, composed direct gaze, wearing the exact BR-004 long hoodie dress — matte jet-black heavyweight cotton-fleece, oversized silhouette falling to mid-thigh, large centered chest graphic of a black rose blooming from clouds with fine-line illustrative detail in white and grey, kangaroo front pocket, ribbed cuffs — black heeled ankle boots. Both figures stand full-body, feet grounded on the same reflective floor plane, separated by deliberate negative space. Occupying 55% of frame width combined, figures at hip-height to top-of-head fully visible.

[COMPOSITION]
Strong horizontal editorial hierarchy: male figure anchored at left strong vertical third, female figure anchored at right strong vertical third, deliberate dark negative space between them drawing the eye to the Black Rose Collection font sculpture centered in the midground behind them. The three-dimensional "The Black Rose Collection" script monument — cast gunmetal and obsidian-lacquered dimensional lettering with the small Black Rose emblem beneath — sits centered on a low black marble plinth between and slightly behind the two figures, physically grounded, lit as a deliberate object of authority. Polished black marble floor extends from foreground to far wall, reflecting both figures and the plinth as sharp contact-shadow reflections. Receding fluted black stone columns at left and right create forced-perspective depth corridors. Foreground edge: subtle shallow out-of-focus dark marble floor texture at frame bottom anchors depth.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Controlled menace, urban monumentality, cinematic restraint. Air is still and pressurized. Deep shadow fills the upper gallery vault. The space feels like a private institution of power — no warmth, no softness, no decoration beyond the garments and the sculpture. Tonal range compressed at the dark end with precise luminance on faces, garment graphics, and the font sculpture.

[LIGHTING]
Three-quarter back rim at 45° camera-left striking the male figure: hard direct strobe at 3200K tungsten casting a sharp-edged shadow behind his left shoulder, defining hoodie construction and sleeve rose graphic with high-contrast precision. Gridded spot from directly overhead descending on the font sculpture plinth at 4000K mixed tungsten-fluorescent, isolating the dimensional lettering as a monument. Motivated practical light from low floor-level gallery uplighters at 2800K candlelight temperature casting narrow vertical bands up the stone columns deep in background. Under-camera fill at 5500K daylight neutral bounced fill lifting faces and chest graphics of both subjects without softening shadow drama. Female figure receives Rembrandt 45° high key from camera-right at 3400K tungsten, preserving the chest graphic legibility and the dress silhouette against the dark background. Soft falloff with gradient transition on all shadow sides — no fill spill into deep background. Floor reflections mirror all light sources as elongated specular streaks on polished marble.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 35mm natural, aperture f/4, moderate depth of field keeping both figures and font sculpture in sharp focus while the far colonnade columns fall into controlled soft focus, anamorphic horizontal feel, slight low camera position at mid-torso height to grant both figures authoritative upward angle without distortion.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Obsidian black dominant across 80% of frame. Cold graphite and gunmetal on stone surfaces and sculpture. Precise white accents: hoodie drawstrings, "OAKLAND" wordmark on shorts, waistband stripe, chest graphic line-work on dress. No warm neutrals, no brown, no color outside this triad. Rich tonal range from near-black at 5% luminance in the vault to controlled white-point at garment graphics only.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Peter Lindbergh, Erwin Olaf, and Dan Tobin Smith. Cinematic editorial fashion photography with luxury product authority and architectural restraint.

[TYPOGRAPHY]
The exact "The Black Rose Collection" three-dimensional script sculpture — gunmetal-cast dimensional lettering in the same cursive weight as the reference logo, with the small Black Rose emblem centered beneath — rendered as a physical monument object on a black marble plinth in the gallery midground between the two figures. Lettering must be legible, structurally accurate to the reference, and lit by the gridded overhead spot as a deliberate hero object. No invented text. No additional words anywhere in the frame.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Magazine editorial cover quality, ultra-sharp on garment graphics and faces, cinematic wide depth, hyper-realistic fabric and stone surface rendering, zero synthetic stock feel, luxury fashion campaign authority.
